about: A session without storage, files or renderer says which port is missing and what to use instead; the commands that need no port (inspect, rename, SVG and JSON export) still work.

steps.text: `doc.autosave` needs persistent storage, which this session does not provide (storage port missing).

text: `doc.export` with format png needs the renderer

steps.text: `doc.save` needs file access, which this session does not provide (files port missing). To get the bytes without writing a file, use `doc.export` with to="inline".
Pass the data inline as `{base64, name}` instead.

expect.note: The refusals left no step; the rename is the last one.
